rationale: The portfolio already holds a full-sized 5.0% long position in CSX. With only 30 minutes remaining in the session and the stock consolidating just under its 5-minute 9-EMA ($51.66) after an extended earnings rally, adding further exposure at the top of the range offers poor incremental risk-reward. Shorting against strong relative strength (3.60x relative volume, trading above VWAP despite a weak broader market) is also unwarranted.
